mood.exercise.breatheBody:
Breathe in for 4
Hold for 7
Breathe out for 8
Repeat a few times and let your shoulders drop.
mood.exercise.stretchBody:
Pick 5 stretches and hold each for 20 seconds.
Neck, shoulders, wrists, back, legs — go slowly.
mood.exercise.groundBody:
Name 5 things you can see
4 you can touch
3 you can hear
2 you can smell
1 you can taste
